title: Relative and global cup products on a ringed site
statement: Work in a common coefficient universe in which the sites are small [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on it; use sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], their sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and the unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with derived tensor product $\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O}$ computed by K-flat resolutions and total tensor complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. Let $f:(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C),\mathcal O_{\mathcal C})\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D),\mathcal O_{\mathcal D})$ be a morphism of ringed topoi [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Use the canonical derived adjunction $Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$, its counit, and the pullback tensor comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact] (K-flat, respectively K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex]); in particular use the canonical isomorphism $\mu:Lf^*(P\otimes^{\mathbf L}Q)\cong Lf^*P\otimes^{\mathbf L}Lf^*Q$. For $K,L\in D(\mathcal O_{\mathcal C})$ the *relative cup product* $c_{K,L}:Rf_*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{\mathcal D}}Rf_*L\to Rf_*(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{\mathcal C}}L)$ is the morphism adjoint to the composite of $\mu$ (for $P=Rf_*K$, $Q=Rf_*L$) with $\varepsilon_K\otimes^{\mathbf L}\varepsilon_L$, where $\varepsilon:Lf^*Rf_*\to\mathrm{id}$ is the counit. For complexes $P,Q$ in $D(\mathcal O_{\mathcal D})$, fix the cohomology pairing $\kappa^{p,q}_{P,Q}:\mathcal H^p(P)\otimes\mathcal H^q(Q)\to\mathcal H^{p+q}(P\otimes^{\mathbf L}Q)$ by choosing K-flat representatives with flat terms and sending local cocycle classes $[x]\otimes[y]$ to $[x\otimes y]$ in the $(p,q)$ summand of the signed total tensor; on cohomology sheaves this prescription is sheafified. The resolution identifications are the canonical ones of [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. For $\mathcal O_{\mathcal C}$-modules $F,G$ and integers $p,q\geq0$, the cup product $R^pf_*F\otimes_{\mathcal O_{\mathcal D}}R^qf_*G\to R^{p+q}f_*(F\otimes_{\mathcal O_{\mathcal C}}G)$, $a\otimes b\mapsto a\smile b$, is the map on cohomology sheaves induced by $c_{F[0],G[0]}$, preceded by $\kappa^{p,q}_{P,Q}$ for $P=Rf_*F[0]$, $Q=Rf_*G[0]$ and followed by the map induced by the canonical morphism $F[0]\otimes^{\mathbf L}G[0]\to(F\otimes G)[0]$ (represented by tensoring K-flat resolution augmentations to $F[0]$ and $G[0]$). Write $\Gamma(\mathcal C,-)$ for compatible families of sections, with pointwise operations [def-sfb-coefficient-module-global-sections], and compute its unbounded derived functor by K-injectives [def-pur-ringed-site-zeroth-hypercohomology]. The *global cup product* is the case $\mathcal D=\mathrm{pt}$, $\mathcal O_{\mathcal D}=A=\Gamma(\mathcal C,\mathcal O_{\mathcal C})$ and $f_*=\Gamma(\mathcal C,-)$: it is a morphism $R\Gamma(\mathcal C,K)\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AR\Gamma(\mathcal C,L)\to R\Gamma(\mathcal C,K\otimes^{\mathbf L}L)$ in $D(A)$ and gives $A$-bilinear maps $H^p(\mathcal C,F)\times H^q(\mathcal C,G)\to H^{p+q}(\mathcal C,F\otimes G)$, where $H^n(\mathcal C,F)$ is the $n$th right derived functor of global sections of the underlying additive sheaf, identified with $H^n(R\Gamma(\mathcal C,F[0]))$ by the canonical comparison of [lem-sfb-ringed-site-global-module-abelian-cohomology]. For a multiplication map $F\otimes G\to H$ of $\mathcal O$-modules (for instance $\mathcal O\otimes\mathcal O\to\mathcal O$, or $\mathcal O\otimes(\mathcal O\otimes_AN)\to\mathcal O\otimes_AN$ for an $A$-module $N$), the cup product with values in $H$ is the composite with the induced map of cohomology. For a scheme or an algebraic space $X$ [def-pc-scheme, def-trf-algebraic-space], these are applied to the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with its structure sheaf $\mathcal O_X$, and for a morphism $f:X\to Y$ to the induced morphism of ringed small etale topoi.
